thesis: Blockchain supplies the objecthood the digital era lacked, and CENTS holds that whole arc in one gesture: its medium is its continual becoming, not any of its visible forms.

distinctions_kept.distinction: FIVE NATURES (what a Cent simultaneously is) vs FIVE TRANSFORMATIONS OF VALUE (what it passes through) - two different lists of five
distinctions_kept.where: 90s cut: the five TRANSFORMATIONS are enacted by the process narration (in circulation, removed, photographed, destroyed, inscribed) and shown as the s04_process chain; only the five NATURES are spoken as a list, on a different diagram. The two are therefore never read as one list.
distinctions_kept.note: The previous film's 'five conditions' matched the TRANSFORMATIONS only. Merging the two lists is the obvious failure here. At 90 seconds there is no room to narrate both fives; narrating only the natures and letting the process carry the transformations is the compression chosen, and it removes rather than creates the merge risk.
